The Mutations d100 ranges are CONFIRMED FROM THE DARYL TOSE EXCEL MUTATIONS SHEET (RT BLOCK), errata-current: the d100 band widths now match the workbook's 'Mutations' sheet column B Rogue Trader block (29 entries) cell-for-cell. _meta.scope: Core only. Manual-dice parity: every test (Willpower) and every result-table roll may be player-entered OR app-rolled (ARCH-006).

insanity._note: Each 10 Insanity Points gained triggers one Trauma Test (Willpower, modified by the current degree's trauma_test_modifier). A FAILED test rolls on the Mental Traumas table at 1d100 + 10 per Degree of Failure.

rows.name: Compulsion
rows.effect: -10 to Intelligence, Fellowship and Perception Tests for 3d10 hours

rows.name: Agitated
rows.effect: Willpower Test each scene or -10 to all Tests, 1d5 days

rows.name: Vivid Nightmares
rows.effect: Fatigued each following day for 1d5 days

corruption._note: Each 10 Corruption Points gained triggers one Malignancy Test (Willpower, modified by the current degree's malignancy_test_modifier). A FAILED test rolls 1d100 on the Malignancies table (re-roll duplicates). Separately, on reaching each mutation_test_threshold the character tests Willpower against two Characteristics; failing either grants a Minor Mutation (Table 14-3, rolled 1d100 on the mutations table).

rows.name: Ill-fortuned
rows.effect: on spending a Fate Point, roll 1d10; 7+ the point is lost with no effect

rows.name: Fell Obsession
rows.effect: sinister fixation (treat as a Minor mental disorder)

rows.name: Hatred
rows.effect: implacable hatred of a chosen group/class; will not aid them

rows.name: Irrational Nausea
rows.effect: Toughness Test near a specific thing or -10 to Tests

rows.name: Night Terrors
rows.effect: daemonic dreams; suffers as Horrific Nightmares

rows.name: Ashen Taste
rows.effect: negative effects of Fatigue are doubled

rows.name: Bloodlust
rows.effect: Willpower Test to stop attacking or let a wounded enemy flee

rows.name: Strange Addiction
rows.effect: Minor compulsion toward a bizarre substance

mutations._note: Table 14-3 (Core Ch. XIV, p.369, per errata v1.4 L301/L536). Failing a Mutation Test at a mutation_test_threshold rolls 1d100 here. The d100 ranges are CONFIRMED from the Daryl Tose Excel Mutations sheet (RT block), errata-current: read cell-for-cell from the workbook's 'Mutations' sheet column B Rogue Trader block (29 entries, the RT version - NOT the Dark Heresy or Navigator blocks also on that sheet). Entries, order, and effects are RAW-faithful. Effect strings are one-line mechanical summaries from the Core prose (no flavour - GW IP). Ranges are gapless/non-overlapping across 1-100.

rows.name: Grotesque
rows.effect: -20 to Fellowship Tests vs 'normals'; +10 to Intimidate Tests

rows.name: Nightsider
rows.effect: gains Dark Sight Trait; -10 to all Tests in bright light unless shielded

rows.name: Mental Regressive
rows.effect: per mental Characteristic (Int/Per/WP/Fel) roll 1d10: 1-5 -1d10, 6-7 halve, 8-9 none, 10 set to 5; +1d10 Insanity

rows.name: Tox Blood
rows.effect: +20 Toughness Tests vs poison; Toughness -1d10, Intelligence -1d10; blood contact forces Difficult (-10) Toughness Test or 1d10 damage ignoring armour & Toughness

rows.name: Wyrdling
rows.effect: gains Psy Rating 2 (or next higher if already a psyker); gains 2 Psychic Techniques of choice, both from the same Discipline, must meet the techniques' requisites, and does NOT gain the Basic Technique (errata v1.4)

rows.name: Degenerate Mind
rows.effect: Int -1d10, Fel -1d10; roll 1d10: 1-3 Frenzy talent, 4-7 Fearless talent, 8-0 From Beyond Trait

rows.name: Clawed/Fanged
rows.effect: gains Natural Weapon Trait (Impact or Rending damage)

rows.name: Necrophage
rows.effect: Toughness +10; gains Regeneration Trait (must eat raw meat or starve)

rows.name: Corrupted Flesh
rows.effect: on taking Critical damage, gains Fear (2) for that round

rows.name: Multiple Appendages
rows.effect: gains Ambidextrous and Two-Weapon Wielder talents; +10 Climb Tests and grapple attacks

rows.name: Malleable
rows.effect: Agility +10; +20 Climb/grapple Tests; fits through spaces 1/4 body size

rows.name: Winged
rows.effect: gains Flyer Trait at rate = Agility Bonus x2

rows.name: Corpulent
rows.effect: +5 Wounds; gains Unnatural Toughness Trait; cannot Run

rows.name: Corrosive Bile
rows.effect: ranged BS attack (Full action, dodgeable not parryable): 1d10+2 Rending or Energy with Tearing

rows.name: Hellspawn
rows.effect: gains Daemonic, Fear (2), and From Beyond Traits
